method: Independent category judgment from the supplied screenshots, contact sheets, and capture metadata only. No product source, external references, other judges, or earlier audits were consulted. 10 means comparable to the best consumer sports experiences within the approved Cup Season identity; sparse content is evaluated only as the captured state, never as proof of normal-state quality.
limits: All requested surfaces/client combinations without a valid row remain not captured/not scored. Native five-destination shell, unseen full profile/history/season/event experiences, system-host widgets/Live Activity, and real human/device behavior are unknown. Contact details and person identities are not transcribed. Full-page web captures freeze a fixed navigation band at capture viewport position; they do not alone prove permanently inaccessible underlying content.
evidence_updates: Final same-source native invited/email/keyboard/setup-keyboard supplement was reviewed. Metadata correction: web/record is a wrong-scene Play capture and is not scored. Book receipt selection is unknown, and native morning-kept remains live phone scoring.
null_cells: M is null for the static web share export, private native credential with no controls, and review-host widgets/Live Activity where actual system interaction geometry is absent. These are not neutral or perfect scores.
